drivingQuestion: What is the status of incense between the fingers of the handfuls?
outcomeNote: The unit ends on the challenge; resolution follows in the next unit.

segments.he: (בֵּין הַבֵּינַיִים, פָּשַׁט, וּמָחַץ, וּפִזֵּר, וְחִשֵּׁב, בַּחֲפִינַת חֲבֵירוֹ — סִימָן). בָּעֵי רַב פָּפָּא: בֵּין הַבֵּינַיִם שֶׁל מְלֹא חׇפְנָיו מַהוּ? מַאי קָא מִבַּעְיָא לֵיהּ? אִי גָּמַר ״מְלֹא״ ״מְלֹא״ מֵהָתָם — הַיְינוּ הָךְ!
segments.en: § «Bein habeinayim, pashat, umaḥatz, ufizer, veḥishev, baḥafinat, ḥaveiro:» This is «a mnemonic» for the ensuing questions of Rav Pappa. «Rav Pappa raised a dilemma: What is» the halakha with regard to the «in-between» incense «of his handfuls?» The Gemara asks: «What is his dilemma? If he derives» the verbal analogy between «“full”» and «“full”» from his handfuls «there,» the case of the meal-offering handful, «this» case «is» the same as «that» one, and therefore the incense between his fingers is invalid. If Rav Pappa does not accept this verbal analogy, what is the basis of his dilemma?
